title: On-device transcription for field surveys
thesis: Models small enough to run on a phone make offline transcription newly possible.
note: A real unlock, but the customer and the willingness to pay are both unestablished.

evidence.title: Small models now run on commodity phones
evidence.body: A quantised model now transcribes faster than real time on a mid-range handset with no network.

evidence.title: Surveyor describes the current process
evidence.body: We record on a handset and type it up in the evening. Signal is unreliable where we work.
